title: Slim_app
summary: A Jupyter notebook analyzing the NSL-KDD network intrusion detection dataset, applying machine learning classifiers and generating synthetic tabular data for the traffic records. The notebook imports sdv.metadata.SingleTableMetadata and runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic intrusion-detection data.
